Package tradeoptima

package tradeoptima
TradeOptima: hand-built advanced algorithms for historical trading analysis. Modules 2 through 6 cover search, constrained optimization, routing, portfolio approximation and randomized risk. Replay is a sequence of independent paper scenarios over already observed prices.
